meta.title: 高中核心句型 100 条
meta.source: AI整理初版(通用教学规范),待人工校对

items.title: 主系表
items.formula: 主语 + be/系动词 + 表语
items.en: He is a doctor. / The flowers look beautiful.
items.cn: 他是医生。／这些花看起来很美。
items.note: 系动词: be, look, seem, feel, sound, taste, smell, become, get, turn, grow, keep, stay

items.title: 主谓
items.formula: 主语 + 不及物动词
items.en: The sun rises in the east.
items.cn: 太阳从东方升起。
items.note: 不及物动词后不可直接接宾语

items.title: 主谓宾
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语
items.en: She is reading an English book.
items.cn: 她正在读一本英语书。

items.title: 主谓双宾
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 间接宾语 + 直接宾语
items.en: My father bought me a new bike.
items.cn: 爸爸给我买了一辆新自行车。
items.note: buy/give/pass/send/show/tell/teach 等;也可改 for/to sb

items.title: 主谓宾宾补
items.formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
items.en: We keep our classroom clean.
items.cn: 我们保持教室干净。
items.note: make/keep/find/see/watch/hear/let/have 等

items.title: There be 存在句
items.formula: There + be + 名词 + 地点/时间
items.en: There is a computer on the desk.
items.cn: 桌上有一台电脑。
items.note: 就近原则; 可接 be going to/happens to/must be 等

items.title: 一般现在时
items.formula: 主语 + do/does + 其他
items.en: I go to school by bus every day.
items.cn: 我每天坐公交车上学。
items.note: 表经常性/习惯性/客观真理

items.title: 现在进行时
items.formula: 主语 + am/is/are + doing
items.en: Look! The children are playing football.
items.cn: 看！孩子们正在踢足球。
items.note: 表正在进行或现阶段

items.title: 现在完成时
items.formula: 主语 + have/has + done
items.en: I have finished my homework already.
items.cn: 我已经完成作业了。
items.note: already/yet/just/ever/never/since/for

items.title: 一般过去时
items.formula: 主语 + did + 其他
items.en: We visited the museum yesterday.
items.cn: 我们昨天参观了博物馆。
items.note: yesterday/ago/last night/in 2020

items.title: 一般将来时
items.formula: 主语 + will/be going to + do
items.en: It will rain tomorrow. / We are going to have a picnic.
items.cn: 明天会下雨。／我们打算去野餐。
items.note: will 表临时决定; be going to 表计划

items.title: It is + adj + to do
items.formula: It is + 形容词 + to do sth
items.en: It is important to learn English well.
items.cn: 学好英语很重要。
items.note: It is + adj + for/of sb + to do; dangerous/necessary/possible/useful

items.title: It is + adj + that 从句
items.formula: It is + 形容词 + that 从句
items.en: It is certain that he will pass the exam.
items.cn: 他一定会通过考试。
items.note: certain/clear/true/wonderful/strange/necessary

items.title: It is + n + that/to do
items.formula: It is + 名词 + that 从句 / to do
items.en: It is a good idea to go swimming. / It is a pity that you missed it.
items.cn: 去游泳是个好主意。／你错过了真可惜。
items.note: pity/shame/pleasure/honor/idea

items.title: It takes sb time to do
items.formula: It takes/took sb + 时间 + to do sth
items.en: It took me two hours to finish the work.
items.cn: 我花了两个小时完成这项工作。
items.note: spend/cost 句型见 S016-S017

items.title: sb spend time doing/on
items.formula: sb + spend 时间/金钱 + (in) doing sth / on sth
items.en: He spends two hours (in) reading every day.
items.cn: 他每天花两小时读书。
items.note: pay/cost 表花费见 S017

items.title: sth cost / sb pay
items.formula: sth cost(s) sb 钱 / sb pay(s) 钱 for sth
items.en: The book cost me 30 yuan. / I paid 30 yuan for the book.
items.cn: 这本书花了我三十元。／我花了三十元买这本书。

items.title: too...to...
items.formula: 主语 + be + too + 形容词/副词 + to do
items.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
items.cn: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
items.note: 表否定结果; too ready/anxious/eager to 表肯定

items.title: ...enough to...
items.formula: 主语 + be + 形容词 + enough + (for sb) to do
items.en: He is old enough to go to school.
items.cn: 他到了上学的年龄了。
items.note: enough 放形容词/副词后

items.title: so...that...
items.formula: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句
items.en: The problem is so difficult that nobody can work it out.
items.cn: 这个问题太难了，没人能解出来。
items.note: so...that 可换 such...that/too...to

items.title: such...that...
items.formula: such + (a/an)+形容词+名词 + that 从句
items.en: It is such an interesting film that we all like it.
items.cn: 这是一部如此有趣的电影，我们都喜欢。
items.note: such...that 与 so...that 互换规则

items.title: as...as 同级比较
items.formula: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as ... / not as(so)...as
items.en: Tom is as tall as Jack. / He does not run so fast as me.
items.cn: 汤姆和杰克一样高。／他跑得不如我快。
items.note: 倍数+as...as 见 S027

items.title: 比较级+than
items.formula: A + be/实义动词 + 比较级 + than B
items.en: This picture is more beautiful than that one.
items.cn: 这幅画比那幅更美。
items.note: much/even/a little/far 修饰比较级

items.title: the+比较级, the+比较级
items.formula: The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...
items.en: The more you read, the more you learn.
items.cn: 你读得越多，学得越多。
items.note: 越……就越……

items.title: 比较级 and 比较级
items.formula: 比较级 + and + 比较级
items.en: Our country is becoming stronger and stronger.
items.cn: 我们的国家变得越来越强大。
items.note: 多音节: more and more beautiful

items.title: 最高级
items.formula: the + 最高级 + in/of/among ...
items.en: He is the tallest student in our class.
items.cn: 他是我们班最高的学生。
items.note: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词

items.title: 倍数表达
items.formula: A is 倍数 + as...as B / 倍数+比较级+than B
items.en: This room is twice as large as that one.
items.cn: 这个房间是那个的两倍大。
items.note: twice/three times 等

items.title: not...until...
items.formula: not...until 直到……才……
items.en: He did not go to bed until his mother came back.
items.cn: 直到妈妈回来他才上床睡觉。
items.note: 倒装句 Not until 从句 did+主语 见语法点

items.title: hardly...when / no sooner...than
items.formula: hardly + 过去完成 + when ... / no sooner + 过去完成 + than ...
items.en: Hardly had I got home when it began to rain.
items.cn: 我刚到家就开始下雨了。
items.note: 一……就……; 前句需倒装

items.title: as soon as 一……就……
items.formula: As soon as + 从句, 主句
items.en: As soon as he arrived, we started the meeting.
items.cn: 他一到，我们就开会了。
items.note: 可换 the moment/immediately/instantly

items.title: be about to do...when...
items.formula: sb + be about to do + when 从句(突然)
items.en: I was about to leave when the telephone rang.
items.cn: 我正要离开，电话铃响了。
items.note: when 前常用过去进行/be about to

items.title: be doing...when...
items.formula: sb + be doing + when 从句(突然)
items.en: We were watching TV when the light went out.
items.cn: 我们正在看电视，突然灯灭了。

items.title: had better do
items.formula: sb + had better (not) do sth
items.en: You had better go to bed early.
items.cn: 你最好早点睡。
items.note: 后接动词原形

items.title: would rather do than do
items.formula: would rather do A than do B
items.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
items.cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。
items.note: prefer to do rather than do 同义

items.title: prefer doing to doing
items.formula: prefer A to B / prefer doing A to doing B
items.en: She prefers singing to dancing.
items.cn: 她宁愿唱歌而不愿跳舞。

items.title: used to do
items.formula: sb used to do sth (过去常常)
items.en: I used to get up late.
items.cn: 我过去常常晚起。
items.note: 否定 didn't use to / used not to; 与 be used to doing 区分

items.title: be used to doing
items.formula: sb + be/get used to + doing sth (习惯)
items.en: He is used to living in the countryside.
items.cn: 他习惯住在乡下。
items.note: to 后接名词/动名词

items.title: be worth doing
items.formula: sth + be worth + doing
items.en: The book is well worth reading.
items.cn: 这本书很值得一读。
items.note: 值得做; worthy of / It is worthwhile to do

items.title: be busy doing
items.formula: sb + be busy doing sth / be busy with sth
items.en: The students are busy preparing for the exam.
items.cn: 学生们正忙着备考。

items.title: keep/stop/prevent sb from doing
items.formula: keep/stop/prevent sb from doing sth
items.en: The rain prevented us from going out.
items.cn: 雨使我们无法外出。
items.note: stop/prevent 可省 from 后接动名词? 通常保留

items.title: make sb do
items.formula: make/let/have sb do sth
items.en: The teacher made us read the text aloud.
items.cn: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。
items.note: 被动: be made to do; 感官动词见 S042

items.title: see/watch/hear sb do/doing
items.formula: see/watch/hear/notice sb do sth 或 doing sth
items.en: I saw him cross the street. / I saw him crossing the street.
items.cn: 我看见他过了街。／我看见他正在过街。
items.note: do 表全过程, doing 表正在进行; 被动 to do

items.title: have sth done
items.formula: have/get sth done
items.en: I had my bike repaired yesterday.
items.cn: 我昨天请人修了自行车。
items.note: 表请人做/遭遇; have sb do; have sth doing

items.title: get sb to do
items.formula: get sb to do sth / get sth doing
items.en: He got his friend to help him.
items.cn: 他让朋友帮他。
items.note: get 后宾补用 to do, have/make 用 do

items.title: It is said/reported that...
items.formula: It is said/reported/believed that 从句
items.en: It is said that he has gone abroad.
items.cn: 据说他出国了。
items.note: 可换 sb is said to do/have done

items.title: sb be said to do
items.formula: sb + be said/reported/believed + to do / to have done
items.en: He is said to be a famous writer.
items.cn: 据说他是一位著名作家。
items.note: 表据说/据报道

items.title: There is no doubt that...
items.formula: There is no doubt that 从句
items.en: There is no doubt that he will win.
items.cn: 毫无疑问他会赢。
items.note: There is no need to do; There is no point doing

items.title: It is (high) time that...
items.formula: It is (high) time that sb did/should do sth
items.en: It is time that we went to bed.
items.cn: 我们该睡觉了。
items.note: 从句用过去时或 should do(虚拟)

items.title: It occurs to sb that...
items.formula: It occurs/occurred to sb that 从句
items.en: It occurred to me that I had left my keys at home.
items.cn: 我突然想起把钥匙落在家里了。
items.note: 某人突然想到

items.title: What if...
items.formula: What if + 句子?
items.en: What if it rains tomorrow?
items.cn: 明天下雨怎么办？
items.note: How about/What about + n/doing

items.title: It is + 一段时间 + since 从句
items.formula: It is/has been + 时间段 + since sb did sth
items.en: It is three years since he left home.
items.cn: 他离开家已经三年了。
items.note: since 从句用一般过去时

items.title: since 现在完成主句
items.formula: 主句(现在完成) + since 从句
items.en: We have known each other since we were children.
items.cn: 我们从小就认识。

items.title: 现在完成 + for 时间段
items.formula: 主语 + have/has done ... for + 时间段
items.en: She has taught English for ten years.
items.cn: 她教英语十年了。
items.note: for 表持续, since 表起点

items.title: It is the first time that...
items.formula: It is/was the first time that 从句(现在完成/过去完成)
items.en: It is the first time that I have visited Beijing.
items.cn: 这是我第一次游览北京。
items.note: This/That is the + 序数词 + time that...

items.title: 感叹句 What
items.formula: What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + (主+谓)!
items.en: What a beautiful day (it is)!
items.cn: 多么美好的一天啊！
items.note: What + 复数/不可数名词时不用 a/an

items.title: 感叹句 How
items.formula: How + 形容词/副词 + (主+谓)!
items.en: How fast the boy runs!
items.cn: 这男孩跑得多快啊！
items.note: How + adj + a/an + n + 主谓!

items.title: 祈使句
items.formula: 动词原形...(否定 Don't/ Never + 动词原形)
items.en: Please close the door. / Don't be late.
items.cn: 请关门。／别迟到。
items.note: Let's 后接 shall we; 肯定祈使句反意用 will you

items.title: 反意疑问句
items.formula: 陈述句, 简短问句?
items.en: He has finished his work, hasn't he?
items.cn: 他完成工作了，不是吗？
items.note: 前肯后否/前否后肯; 祈使句、there be 等特殊反意

items.title: 选择疑问句
items.formula: 一般疑问句 + or + 另一选项?
items.en: Do you want tea or coffee?
items.cn: 你要茶还是咖啡？

items.title: 特殊疑问句
items.formula: 疑问词 + 一般疑问句?
items.en: Where are you going? / Why did you say that?
items.cn: 你要去哪儿？／你为什么那么说？
items.note: 疑问词作主语时语序不倒装: Who told you?

items.title: So do I 类倒装
items.formula: So + 助动词 + 主语 (也……)
items.en: I like music. So does my sister.
items.cn: 我喜欢音乐，我妹妹也喜欢。
items.note: 否定用 Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语

items.title: either...or... / neither...nor...
items.formula: either A or B / neither A nor B / not only A but also B + 谓语(就近)
items.en: Either you or he is wrong.
items.cn: 要么你错，要么他错。
items.note: 就近原则; not only 位于句首倒装见语法

items.title: both...and...
items.formula: both A and B + 复数谓语
items.en: Both Tom and Jack are good at English.
items.cn: 汤姆和杰克都擅长英语。
items.note: not...but...; whether...or...

items.title: as if 从句
items.formula: 主句 + as if + 从句(陈述/虚拟)
items.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
items.cn: 他说起话来好像什么都知道。
items.note: 与事实相反用虚拟(过去时/过去完成)

items.title: even if / even though
items.formula: Even if/though + 从句, 主句
items.en: Even if it rains, we will go on with the work.
items.cn: 即使下雨，我们也会继续工作。
items.note: 即使; 让步状语从句

items.title: although/though 让步
items.formula: Although/Though + 从句, 主句
items.en: Although he is old, he works hard.
items.cn: 虽然年纪大了，他仍然努力工作。
items.note: 不与 but 连用, 可与 yet 连用

items.title: if 条件句(主将从现)
items.formula: If + 一般现在时, 主句(将来时/祈使/情态)
items.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will go climbing.
items.cn: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
items.note: 主将从现; 主句不可用将来时的从句除外

items.title: unless 除非
items.formula: 主句 + unless + 从句(=if...not)
items.en: You will fail the exam unless you work hard.
items.cn: 除非你努力，否则考试会不及格。

items.title: because/since/as 原因
items.formula: Because/Since/As + 原因从句, 主句
items.en: Because it rained, we stayed at home.
items.cn: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。
items.note: because 语气最强; 不与 so 连用

items.title: so that 目的/结果
items.formula: 主句 + so that + 从句
items.en: He got up early so that he could catch the bus.
items.cn: 他起得很早以便能赶上公交车。
items.note: 目的从句常用 can/could/may/might

items.title: so...that 结果(复习)
items.formula: so + 形/副 + that 从句
items.en: She was so tired that she fell asleep at once.
items.cn: 她太累了，马上就睡着了。
items.note: 见 S020

items.title: where 地点状语从句
items.formula: 主句 + where 从句
items.en: Put the book where it was.
items.cn: 把书放回原处。
items.note: 与定语从句区分: 缺先行词

items.title: when/while/as 时间
items.formula: When/While/As + 时间从句, 主句
items.en: While I was reading, my mother came in.
items.cn: 我读书时，妈妈进来了。
items.note: while+进行/持续性动词

items.title: before/after 时间
items.formula: 主句 + before/after + 从句
items.en: Think it over before you answer.
items.cn: 回答之前先想清楚。
items.note: before 常译作 才/还没来得及

items.title: 宾语从句
items.formula: 主语 + 谓语 + that/if/whether/疑问词 + 从句
items.en: I don't know whether he will come.
items.cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
items.note: 陈述语序; 时态呼应

items.title: 主语从句
items.formula: That/Whether/疑问词 + 从句 + 谓语 / It is...that...
items.en: What he said is true.
items.cn: 他说的是真的。
items.note: 常用 it 作形式主语

items.title: 表语从句
items.formula: 主语 + be + 连接词 + 从句
items.en: The reason is that he was ill.
items.cn: 原因是他病了。
items.note: because 引导表语从句表原因

items.title: 同位语从句
items.formula: 名词(fact/news/idea/hope...) + that 从句
items.en: The news that our team won made us happy.
items.cn: 我们队获胜的消息让我们高兴。
items.note: 与定语从句区分: that 不充当成分

items.title: 定语从句(关系代词)
items.formula: 先行词 + who/whom/which/that/whose + 从句
items.en: The girl who is singing is my sister.
items.cn: 正在唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。
items.note: who 人/which 物/that 均可; whose 表所属

items.title: 定语从句(关系副词)
items.formula: 先行词 + where/when/why + 从句
items.en: This is the house where I lived.
items.cn: 这是我住过的房子。
items.note: where 地点/when 时间/why 原因

items.title: 非限制性定语从句
items.formula: 先行词, + who/which/whose/... + 从句
items.en: My father, who is a doctor, works very hard.
items.cn: 我爸爸是医生，工作非常努力。
items.note: 逗号隔开; 不用 that; which 可指整句

items.title: the way + 定语
items.formula: the way (that/in which) + 从句
items.en: I don't like the way he talks.
items.cn: 我不喜欢他说话的方式。

items.title: with 复合结构
items.formula: with + 宾语 + 宾补(形/副/介/doing/done/to do)
items.en: He fell asleep with the light on.
items.cn: 他开着灯睡着了。
items.note: 独立主格结构类似: 名词+分词

items.title: so/neither 简短反应
items.formula: So it is with sb / It is the same with sb
items.en: Tom likes sports, and so it is with Jim.
items.cn: 汤姆喜欢运动，吉姆也一样。
items.note: 混合肯定否定时用 So it is with...

items.title: 强调句
items.formula: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余
items.en: It was in Beijing that we met.
items.cn: 我们是在北京相遇的。
items.note: 强调人可用 who; 不可强调谓语(谓语用 do/does/did)

items.title: do/does/did 强调谓语
items.formula: 主语 + do/does/did + 动词原形
items.en: I do believe that he is honest.
items.cn: 我确实相信他是诚实的。
items.note: 只用于一般现在/过去时肯定句

items.title: not only...but also... 倒装
items.formula: Not only + 从句(倒装) but also 主句
items.en: Not only did he come, but also he helped us.
items.cn: 他不仅来了，还帮了我们。
items.note: 位于句首从句倒装

items.title: only + 状语 倒装
items.formula: Only + 状语/状语从句 + 部分倒装
items.en: Only by working hard can you succeed.
items.cn: 只有努力工作你才能成功。
items.note: only+主语不倒装

items.title: 否定词位于句首倒装
items.formula: Never/Hardly/Seldom/Not only/Not until + 部分倒装
items.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
items.cn: 我从未见过这么美的地方。
items.note: 详见语法点-倒装

items.title: there be 变体
items.formula: There + 情态动词/be going to/happen to/seem to + be
items.en: There used to be a tree in front of the house.
items.cn: 房子前面过去有一棵树。

items.title: 抽象名词代替从句
items.formula: sb + 动词 + 抽象名词(idea/fact/point) + that 从句
items.en: The fact that he failed surprised us.
items.cn: 他失败的事实让我们惊讶。
items.note: 参见 S078

items.title: in order to / so as to
items.formula: 主句 + in order to / so as to + 动词原形
items.en: He studies hard in order to go to college.
items.cn: 他努力学习以便上大学。
items.note: so as to 不放句首

items.title: regardless of / despite
items.formula: 主句 + regardless of / despite/in spite of + 名词
items.en: He went out despite the heavy rain.
items.cn: 尽管下大雨，他还是出去了。
items.note: 后接名词/动名词

items.title: thanks to / due to / owing to
items.formula: Thanks to/Owing to + 名词, 主句
items.en: Thanks to your help, I finished the task.
items.cn: 多亏你的帮助，我完成了任务。
items.note: 表原因; 句首句尾皆可

items.title: when it comes to
items.formula: When it comes to + 名词/doing
items.en: When it comes to learning English, practice is the key.
items.cn: 说到学英语，练习是关键。

items.title: as far as I know
items.formula: As far as I know, ...
items.en: As far as I know, he has never been abroad.
items.cn: 据我所知，他从没出过国。
items.note: 就我所知

items.title: in my opinion 观点句
items.formula: In my opinion, ... / I think that...
items.en: In my opinion, we should protect the environment.
items.cn: 依我看，我们应该保护环境。
items.note: 表达观点常用句型

items.title: It seems/appears that...
items.formula: It seems/appears that 从句 / sb seems to do
items.en: It seems that he is very happy.
items.cn: 他似乎很开心。
items.note: 可换 He seems to be very happy.

items.title: there is no doing
items.formula: There is no doing sth (不可能/没法……)
items.en: There is no knowing what will happen.
items.cn: 没法知道会发生什么。
items.note: There is no point/use/good doing 亦常见

items.title: It depends on 等口头句型
items.formula: It (all) depends. / That depends on...
items.en: Whether we go depends on the weather.
items.cn: 我们去不去取决于天气。
items.note: 口语常用; depend on 后接名词/从句
